name: Jacquard (formerly Phrasee)

hlido_opinion.headline: An established enterprise marketing-language vendor, now rebranded to Jacquard and repositioned as an agentic layer - credible product, zero public price, and headline statistics we cannot check.
hlido_opinion.body: This is the clearest case in the batch of a real company whose public surface works against it. The product is an enterprise creative-intelligence layer: agents that pull a campaign estate, assess 90 days of opens, clicks and revenue, rank underperforming campaigns, map optimisable slots and plan experiments - all with the operator approving content before it ships. The human-sign-off step is stated rather than implied, which matters for a tool that writes brand copy at volume, and the orchestration walkthrough on the homepage is specific enough to be about something real. The company is also not new to this category; it has been doing marketing-language optimisation at enterprise scale for years, which is why the rebrand is worth naming rather than glossing. Two things hold the verdict down, and both are properties of the public surface rather than guesses about the product. First, the record is published under the slug phrasee while the live site presents as Jacquard - a rename in progress, which means buyers searching either name may not find the other, and our own record has to carry both. Second, the headline numbers - 30M+ messages sent weekly, 80B+ real results learned from, +23.3% average engagement lift - are the entire quantitative case for the product and none of them carries a methodology, a date, a population or a source anywhere we could reach. An average lift figure in particular is meaningless without knowing the baseline and the selection. There is no pricing of any kind: the only paths forward are 'book a demo' and a free brand analysis. For a procurement desk that is a cost, not a neutral choice. We are not saying the figures are wrong; we are saying the surface gives nobody a way to confirm them, and a vendor with this much real data could publish the methodology and remove the doubt in a paragraph.

tier_rationale: STEADY (70), at the floor of the band. It holds STEADY because the product is substantive and specifically described, the agent workflow is concrete down to the approval step, and the vendor is an established operator in this category rather than a new entrant. It is at the floor, not higher, because the three headline statistics that carry the product's entire quantitative argument are unverifiable from the public surface, no pricing of any kind is disclosed, and the live brand name does not match the name this product is known and indexed under.
what_it_does_well: Agent workflow is described concretely - pulls the campaign estate, assesses 90 days of performance, ranks underperformers, maps slots, plans named experiments
Human approval is an explicit step, not an afterthought, for a system that writes brand copy at volume
Brand-voice constraint is a first-class product concept rather than a prompt setting
Offers a free brand analysis, giving a prospect a way to see output before committing to a sales process
Established operator in enterprise marketing-language optimisation rather than a first-time entrant
what_it_fails_at: No pricing of any kind is published - the only routes are a demo booking or a free analysis
Three headline statistics (30M+ weekly messages, 80B+ results, +23.3% average engagement lift) carry no methodology, date, population or source
The average-lift figure has no stated baseline or selection, which is what would make it meaningful
Live brand (Jacquard) differs from the name the product is indexed under (Phrasee), splitting discoverability
No programmatic surface for agents - no API, CLI, MCP or SDK evident on the public surface
Parts of the product are marked SOON on the in-product navigation shown on the homepage
best_for: Enterprise marketing teams with a large existing campaign estate and the volume to justify optimisation
Brands that need generated copy constrained to an approved voice with a human sign-off gate
Teams who already run adaptive testing and want it planned and sequenced rather than hand-built
not_recommended_for: Small teams or anyone needing to evaluate cost before entering a sales process - no price is published
Buyers who require published methodology behind performance claims
Agent-driven stacks needing programmatic control - no API, CLI or MCP surface is evident
Anyone needing self-serve onboarding - the surface is demo-gated throughout
red_flags: Three headline performance statistics carry the product's quantitative case and none is traceable to a methodology, date or population on the public surface; the +23.3% average engagement lift in particular has no stated baseline
No pricing is published anywhere on the public surface, so total cost cannot be assessed before a sales conversation
The site presents as Jacquard while the product is indexed as Phrasee - a rename in progress that splits search and may invalidate links and documentation references

compared_to.verdict_diff: Persado is the closest direct competitor in enterprise marketing-language generation and sits with the same structural problem - enterprise sales motion, no public pricing. Choose between them on the specifics of your campaign estate and the evidence each will show you under NDA, because neither can be separated on published evidence alone.

Jasper is self-serve and priced in public, aimed at teams producing content rather than optimising an existing estate. Choose Jasper if you need to start this week at a known cost; choose Jacquard if you have a large live estate and the procurement patience for an enterprise engagement.

evidence_urls.claim: Agentic creative layer that plans, writes, checks and optimises marketing content in a brand voice with operator sign-off
Orchestration agent assesses 90 days of opens, clicks and revenue and plans adaptive tests per campaign
Free brand analysis offered without a demo booking
Site presents the brand as Jacquard, not Phrasee
Headline statistics 30M+ messages weekly, 80B+ results learned from, +23.3% average engagement lift are published without methodology or source

agent_relevance.agent_integration_path: None evident. The product is a hosted enterprise application with its own agent workflow and in-product connectors; no API, CLI, MCP server or SDK is documented on the public surface, so an external agent cannot drive or configure it. Useful as a destination system a human operates, not as a component in an agent stack.

checklist.evidence: 'Jacquard is the agentic creative intelligence layer that makes your brand resonate everywhere.'
No pricing published anywhere on the public surface; routes are demo booking or a free brand analysis
In-product screenshots and an orchestration walkthrough are shown, but no live demo, trial or named case evidence is reachable without a sales conversation

summary: An established enterprise marketing-language vendor, now rebranded to Jacquard and repositioned as an agentic layer - credible product, zero public price, and headline statistics we cannot check.
